senses.gloss: शुक्ल- + अपाङ्ग शुक्ल- + अपाङ्ग, m. a peacock.
सु-कृत- + उच्छ्रय सु-कृत- + उच्छ्रय, adj. very lofty, MBh. 1, 6963.
सु- + कपोल सु- + कपोल, adj., f. ला, having beautiful cheeks, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 22.

सु- + कर सु- + कर,
 I. adj., f. री. 1. easy, Man. 7, 55. 2. doing well []
 II. f. रा, a tractable cow.
 III. n. charity, benevolence.
शूकर शूकर, m. A hog, Hit. 57, 12, M.M. f. री, A sow. Cf. सूकर.

सूकर सू-कर,
 I. m.
 1. A hog (see शूकर).
 2. The hog-deer.
 3. A potter.
 II. f. री, A sort of moss, [] Lycopodium imbricatum.
 --With the first part cf. Lat. sus; σῦς, ὗς, σύαινα; O.H.G. sû; A.S. sugu; Goth. svein; A.S. swin.

सु- + कर्मन् सु- + कर्मन्,
 I. adj. 1. one who performs beautiful works, Rājat. 5, 115. 2. virtuous. 11. m. the artist of the gods.
सु- + कवि सु- + कवि, m. an excellent [] poet, Rājat. 5, 204.
सु- + कविता सु- + कविता, f. excellent poetical talent, Bhartṛ. 2, 18.

सु- + कुमार सु- + कुमार,
 I. adj. 1. soft, smooth. 2. youthful. 3. delicate.
 II. m., and f. रा, names of several plants.

सु- + कृत सु- + कृत,
 I. adj. 1. done well. 2. treated with kindness. 3. virtuous, pious. 4. fortunate.
 II. n. 1. a virtuous act, Man. 3, 37. 2. kindness. 3. virtue. 4. fortune.
सु- + कृति सु- + कृति, f. 1. kindness. 2. virtue. 3. the practice of religious austerities.
सु- + कृतिन् सु- + कृतिन्, adj. 1. benevolent, 2. virtuous, pious. 3. fortunate. 4. wise, learned.
शुक्ल- + केश शुक्ल- + केश, adj. hoary-haired.
सु- + केश सु- + केश, adj., f. शी, having beautiful hair, Rām. 3, 52, 35.
सूक्ष्म- + दर्शिन् सूक्ष्म- + दर्शिन्, adj. acute. intelligent.
शुक्ल- + पक्ष शुक्ल- + पक्ष, m. the light half of the month, from new to full moon.
शुक- + वाह शुक- + वाह, m. Kāma.
सूक्ष्म- + शरीर सूक्ष्म- + शरीर, n. atom-like body, a Vedāntic term, Vedāntas. in Chr. 208, 5.
† शुक् शुक्, i. 1. Par. To go.
षुक्क् षुक्क्, see ष्वस्क्.

शुक शुक,
 I. m.
 1. A parrot, Vikr. d. 41.
 2. A proper name.
 II. m. and n. The name of several plants.
 III. n.
 1. A turban.
 2. The hem of a cloth.
 3. Cloth.
 4. A sort of perfume.
 --Comp.

शूक शूक, m. and n.
 1. The awn [] of barley.
 2. A bristle, a spicula.
 3. Compassion.
 --Comp.

सूक 2. सू + क, m.
 1. An arrow.
 2. Air, wind.

शुक्त शुक्त,
 I. adj.
 1. Sour, acid.
 2. Harsh.
 3. i. e. 2. शुच् + त, Clean, pure.
 II. n.
 1. A preparation which has become acid by undergoing fermentation, as vinegar, etc., Man. 2, 177; 4, 211; 11, 153.
 2. Sour gruel.
 3. Flesh.

सूक्त सूक्त, i. e. सु-उक्त (vb. वच्),
 I. adj. Well or properly said.
 II. n.
 1. A hymn.
 2. A sentence, Pañc. 266, 5.
 3. pl. Seducing words, MBh. 8, 2037.
शुक्तक शुक्त + क (n.), Sour eructation, Man. 4, 121 (Lois.).

शुक्ति शुक्ति, i. e. 2. शुच् + ति, f.
 1. A pearl oyster, Pañc. i. d. 280.
 2. A conch.
 3. A small shell.
 4. A portion of the skull used as a cup.
 5. A curl or feather on a horse's neck or breast.
 6. A disease of the cornea.
 7. A sort of perfume.
 8. A weight of two कर्षस्.
 --Comp.
सूक्ति सूक्ति, i. e. सु-उक्ति, f. Kind speech, Rājat. 5, 188.
शुक्तिज शुक्ति-ज (vb. जन्), n. A pearl.

शुक्र शुक्र, i. e. 2. शुच् + र,
 I. adj.
 1. Resplendent, Chr. 288, 14 = Rigv. i. 48, 14.
 2. Pure, Windischmann, Sankara, 68.
 II. m.
 1. A name of Agni.
 2. The planet Venus, Pañc. pr. d. 3. []
 3. The month Jyeṣṭhā (May--June), Hiḍ. 1, 10.
 III. n.
 1. Semen virile, Vedāntas. in Chr. 207, 13; MBh. 1, 2434; male and female strength, Man. 3, 49.
 2. A morbid affection of the iris.
शुक्रल शुक्र + ल, adj. Spermatic, augmenting the seminal secretion.

शुक्ल शुक्ल, i. e. 2. शुच् + ल,
 I. adj. White, Pañc. i. d. 39; bright, i. d. 104; Man. 1, 66 (with पक्ष, the fortnight of the month in which the moon increases).
 II. m.
 1. White (the colour).
 2. One of the astronomical योगस्.
 3. The light half of the month from new to full moon. Bhag. 8, 24; Rājat. 5, 412.
 III. f. ला, A name of Sarasvatī.
 IV. n.
 1. Silver.
 2. Fresh butter.
 3. A disease of the cornea.
 --Comp.
शुक्लाभिजातीय शुक्लाभिजातीय, i. e. शुक्ल-अभि-जन् + ति + ईय, adj. Of a pure race, Rām. 6, 10, 24.
शुक्षि शुक्षि, m. Wind.
शुक्र- + शोचिस् शुक्र- + शोचिस्, adj. possessed of a resplendent lustre, Lass. 102, 7 = Rigv. vii. 14, 1.
सु-कर- + संधि सु-कर- + संधि, adj. easy to be joined or united, Pañc. ii. d. 36.
शुक- + सप्तति शुक- + सप्तति, f. seventy tales of a parrot, title of a work, Lass. 38, 6.
सुकालिन् सुकालिन्, probably सु -2. काल + इन्, m. pl. The Manes of the Śūdras, Man. 3, 197.

सुकृत् सु-कृ + त्, adj.
 1. Virtuous, pious, Chr. 294, 3 = Rigv. i. 92, 3; Pañc. ii. d. 170.
 2. Fortunate.

सूक्ष्म सूक्ष्म, i. e. perhaps सु-क्षाम (but cf. also सूच्),
 I. adj.
 1. Little, small, Pañc. i. d. 254; Bhartṛ. 2, 90.
 2. Atomic, atom-like, Man. 1, 7; 22.
 3. Fine, delicate, tender, Rām. 3, 49, 3; 52, 9; Pañc. i. d. 395.
 4. Subtle, exact, Pañc. 62, 12. ˚मम्, adv. Attentively, Utt. Rāmac. 154, 10.
 II. m.
 1. An atom.
 2. Clearingnut plant, Strychnos potatorum.
 III. f. मा.
 1. A kind of jasmine.
 2. Small cardamoms.
 3. A sort of perfume.
 IV. n.
 1. Fine thread.
 2. The supreme soul.
 3. Subtlety, craft.
 4. Fraud.
 --Comp.
सूक्ष्मता सूक्ष्म + ता, f. Subtlety, the subtle essence, Man. 6, 65.
सूक्ष्मत्व सूक्ष्म + त्व, n. Fineness, subtilty, Bhag. 13, 15.
सूक्ष्मदर्शिता सूक्ष्मदर्शिता, i. e. सूक्ष्म-दर्शिन् + ता, f. Acuteness, wisdom, Mālav. 21, 17.
सु-कुल- + स्त्री सु-कुल- + स्त्री, f. a respect able woman, Cāṇ. 36 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 409.
